headline: Dave Bautista is Kratos in the God of War TV show
title: Dave Bautista Is Kratos | God of War TV Series Update | Prime Video
video_script: Dave Bautista is the new Kratos. Amazon's God of War series is coming to Prime Video, and Bautista was confirmed in the role on August twentieth, twenty twenty six, after Ryan Hurst tore his bicep filming a stunt. Callum Vinson plays Atreus, and the cast includes Mandy Patinkin as Odin and Ed Skrein as Baldur. Ronald D Moore is the showrunner, and Amazon has ordered two seasons. Good choice for Kratos? Comment below!
description: Dave Bautista was confirmed as Kratos in Amazon's God of War series on August 20, 2026, after Ryan Hurst's injury. Callum Vinson plays Atreus; Mandy Patinkin is Odin, Ed Skrein is Baldur. Showrunner Ronald D. Moore, two seasons ordered.
